offering_description.value: Brews, markets and sells beer and other malt-based beverages across North America, Europe and other international markets. Sells mainly to wholesale distributors, retailers and bars, which sell to individual consumers, and makes the products in its own breweries.

primary_products.value: beer; hard seltzer; ready-to-drink cocktails; non-alcoholic malt beverages

customer_segment.value: B2B: wholesale beer distributors, national and regional retail chains, bars, restaurants and stadiums

end_markets.value: alcoholic beverages; retail; on-premise hospitality; convenience and grocery

revenue_model.value: product sales: beer and beverages sold to distributors, retailers and on-premise accounts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: brews and packages beer in its own breweries, sold to distributors and retailers; brand owner: owns and markets its beer and beverage brands, sold through wholesale and retail channels

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Central and Eastern Europe, and export markets in Asia and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: beer, hard seltzer, ready-to-drink cocktails and non-alcoholic beverages sharing breweries and distribution

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent wholesale beer distributors that deliver to retail and on-premise accounts; third-party retail: grocery, convenience, liquor and mass retail chains; direct sales: national accounts and large on-premise customers served directly
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: alcohol production, labeling, advertising and sales need licenses and face excise taxes under federal, state, provincial and EU rules
